svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 303 mm of 315 mm pipe. Wrap a strip of card round the pipe as a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: guide, saw square with a fine-tooth saw, and file both ends flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two nozzle holes, on opposite sides, each with four bolt holes. Tape the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: full-size template (nozzle hole template) to the pipe: its centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is 208.6 mm up from the bottom end; the second hole is the same,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turned half a turn round the pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain drill inside the hole outline with 6 mm, cut out with a jigsaw,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: file to the line. Drill the eight bolt holes 6.6 mm square to the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The holes are larger than the nozzle tip by 2.5 mm all round; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nozzle saddle and its gasket cover them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 3 mm at the top sits in the groove under the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each nozzle passes through its hole without touching the edge.
